why: A seal that counts only its own run's commits. The record door reaches these only with a run filed in a git repository, a finish read on the seal-read thread, and for the carried commits a seal already written. tests/a-seal-takes-only-its-own-runs-commits.test.ts meets each through the door.

refusals.english: Test: only the office writes the commit a run was filed at.
Test: only the office writes the commit a run ended at.
Test: only the office writes the commits a seal carried.
Test: the branch holds a commit that is not the run's own.
Test: a records seal would leave out the run's own commits.
Test: the run's working directory could not be read as the repository it was filed in.
